title: Scaffold & base map
Vite + TypeScript project scaffolded
acceptance: package.json has vite + typescript deps; npm run dev starts without error

title: MapLibre GL base map renders full-bleed dark basemap
acceptance: npm run dev loaded in a browser shows a pannable, zoomable world map with no console errors

title: Project folder structure (src/map, src/data, src/ui)
acceptance: ls src shows map, data, and ui directories

title: Live aircraft layer
adsb.lol fetch client bounded to current viewport
acceptance: src/data/adsbClient.ts exports a function that fetches live aircraft for a lat/lon/radius and returns parsed records with lat, lon, track, altitude, speed, callsign
note: verified live via /api/aircraft proxy returning parsed records with lat/lon/track/altitude/speed/callsign over Western Europe

title: Plane markers rendered with heading rotation
acceptance: a MapLibre layer renders a plane icon per aircraft whose rotation is bound to each aircraft track field; rotating/panning the map shows icons pointing along their reported heading
note: screenshot confirms ~970 heading-rotated plane icons over France/Benelux/Germany

title: Click-for-detail panel
acceptance: clicking a plane marker in the browser opens a panel showing callsign, altitude, ground speed, heading, and squawk for that aircraft
note: clicked a marker in a live browser, panel showed KLM744 B772 PH-BQN, 23750ft, 443kt, hdg 64, squawk 6330

title: Auto-refresh loop tied to viewport, cleaned up correctly
acceptance: the aircraft layer refetches on a fixed interval and on pan/zoom (debounced); devtools shows exactly one active poll interval at a time, none left running after navigating away
note: stop() clears interval+debounce timer and removes the moveend listener; functionally verified refetch on pan/zoom and on the 12s interval across a full walkthrough

title: Polish & local verification
Dark live-intel theme across map and UI chrome
acceptance: base map style and all panels share a consistent dark theme and accent color, confirmed visually in the browser

title: Search/filter by callsign
acceptance: typing a callsign in the search box flies the map to and highlights the matching in-view aircraft
note: search for KLM744 flew to and opened its detail panel; a bogus callsign correctly reports not in view

title: Live stats bar (aircraft count, last update time)
acceptance: the header shows an aircraft-in-view count and a last-updated timestamp that both change after a refresh

title: Full manual walkthrough with zero console errors
acceptance: npm run dev loaded in a browser; pan, zoom, search, and click-for-detail walkthrough completes with zero console errors
note: full Playwright walkthrough (load, pan, zoom, search, close panel, wait for auto-refresh) completed with zero console errors

title: Ship to GitHub
Git repo initialized with a correct .gitignore
acceptance: git status is clean after the initial commit; node_modules and dist are not tracked

title: Public GitHub repo created and pushed
acceptance: gh repo view <owner>/aerotrack succeeds and shows the pushed main branch

title: Deploy to Vercel
Vercel build config correct for the static Vite app
acceptance: vercel build (or an equivalent local production build) completes without error

title: Production deployment live and verified
acceptance: the deployed Vercel URL returns 200, and opening it in a browser shows live aircraft on the map with zero console errors
